title: Plynth machine settings, version 5
description: Settings that belong to one computer rather than to one project. Saved as %APPDATA%/Plynth/settings.json, or in the folder named by the PLYNTH_CONFIG_DIR environment variable. Paths are absolute, UTF-8, with forward slashes. A missing field takes its default; an unknown field is refused. Older files are upgraded when read: version 1 (settings.v1.schema.json) gets an empty recent_projects list, version 2 (settings.v2.schema.json) loses thumbnail_engine, because thumbnails are rendered with Eevee only, version 3 (settings.v3.schema.json) is read as it is, and version 4 (settings.v4.schema.json) loses tour_done, since Plynth has no first run tour any more.

library.description: The Library folder (assets, materials, generators, shapes). Null until chosen.

projects.description: Where new projects are made and where the built-in terminal starts when no project is open. Null until chosen.

blender.description: The blender.exe picked by the user. Null means the newest supported install found is used.

keep_imported_zips.description: Keep a zip after its asset was imported. When false the zip is moved to the Recycle Bin.

triangle_warning.description: Imports with more triangles than this get a warning. Never refused.

setup_checked_version.description: The Plynth version whose setup check last passed. When it differs from the running version the setup check opens once.

side_panel.description: The right side panel of the main window, which shows the properties of what is selected.

open.description: False when the panel was closed.

width.description: Its width in pixels. 0 means the width of the theme.

windows.description: Where each of the app's own windows (Assets, Materials, Sources, Build, Export, Import materials) was last left, by window name.

screen.description: The name of the screen it was on. Empty when unknown.

recent_projects.description: Projects opened or saved by the app, most recent first, at most 30. Shown on the home screen.

path.description: The project folder, absolute, with forward slashes.

name.description: The project name when it was last opened.
